Type: lamp
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Mid Century Modern 3 Light Living Room Standing Floor Lamp with Integrated LED Light - 67.5 Inches, Antique Brass Finish
Colors: Antique Brass
Rotate right, rotate left, rotate where you need lighting. Plated antique brass finishes with a wood inspired base bring design and convenience to help you complete tasks. No need to worry about replacing bulbs as the LEDs are integrated, saving you time and money. 25.75" W x 10" D x 67.5“H Metal in a plated antique brass finish with a wood inspired base Adjust the 3 lights 180 degrees sideways for directional lighting where you need it, on/off switch on each arm, perfect for an office, living room, or bedroom Energy Efficient Integrated LED technology saves you time and money, no bulbs to replace
